keyFindings.title: **F5-5. Sanity check vs baseline.** 555 − 75 = ~480 lines (−13.5%) from physical-line removals alone; byte-compression (F3-*) adds token savings without changing the line count. Risk-adjusted recommendation: Tier 1+2 only (~71 lines) for the first pass; Tier 3 + byte-compression as follow-up. No candidate touches the Four Laws, gates, or verification tables; the Iron Law (L11) is preserve-set.
